verdict.rationale: Mercury's own marketing says it syncs with QuickBooks, Xero and NetSuite and offers AI-powered automations for closing the books, and it auto-attaches emailed or uploaded receipts to card transactions. That is first-party support for the story, but the sync is documented only as a single homepage line, with no detail on what it covers or how it runs. missing for 10: documentation that transactions and expenses (reimbursements, receipts, categories) actually flow into the accounting system, confirmation that sync is automatic or continuous rather than manual export, account and category mapping details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can sync transactions and expenses automatically with my accounting software

citations.quote: Sync with Quickbooks, Xero or NetSuite, and save hours with AI-powered automations to close your books faster.
Email or upload receipts and we’ll auto-attach them to the right card transaction.
